questions.html:
Consider the following statements about the scan design methodology.

A. Replacing a D flip-flop with a scan cell decreases the overall area because a scan cell is smaller than a D flip-flop.
B. Replacing a D flip-flop with a scan cell can increase the setup slack of some timing paths to the D-pin because scan cells have an extra delay of the multiplexer on the D-pin path.
C. The purpose of replacing a flip-flop with a scan cell is to improve the tolerance of a circuit against electromigration. 

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

questions.html: From the perspective of design for test (DFT), which of the following statements best describes a test vector:
options: Any input pattern that produces don’t cares (X) values at the output of a fault-free circuit.
Any input pattern that produces a high impedance state (Z) at the output of a faulty circuit.
Any input pattern, or sequence of input patterns, that produces a 0 for a faulty circuit and a fault-free circuit.
Any input pattern, or sequence of input patterns, that produces a 1 for a faulty circuit and a fault-free circuit.
Any input pattern, or sequence of input patterns, that produces a different output response for a faulty circuit and a fault-free circuit.

questions.html: Which of the following statements best describes the problem of using a simple AND gate for clock gating?
options: In some cases, it can cause the output of the AND gate to get stuck at zero, and the circuit will go into a metastable state.
In some cases, it can cause the output of the AND gate to get stuck at one, and the circuit will go into a metastable state.
It can create glitches at the AND gate's output, which can unnecessarily trigger a flip-flop in its fanout.
It cannot switch off the power supply and cannot save any power.
It can decrease dynamic power dissipation by increasing the load on the clock signal.
It can cause a significant voltage drop in the supply lines, increasing delays in other circuit elements.

B. It obtains the information on the leakage power for each cell from the library file given in the Liberty format.
C. It computes the power dissipated within a cell using the NLPM in the library file.

Which statements are correct?
